title: Update On Effectiveness Of Additional Levy On Cars Sold Between Fourth And Sixth Month Of Ownership
what_it_is: Update On Effectiveness Of Additional Levy On Cars Sold Between Fourth And Sixth Month Of Ownership

sections.label: Cat A Cat B ownership transfer
sections.summary: Cat A and Cat B COE cars may apply to transfer ownership only three months after registration.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Cars registered under Category A (Cat A) and Category B (Cat B) of the Certificate of Entitlement (COE) are only allowed to apply for a transfer of vehicle ownership three months after the date of registration.

sections.label: LTA additional levy waiver requests
sections.summary: Over five years, LTA received on average three annual requests to waive the additional levy payable by vehicle owners.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Over the last five years, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) received, on average, three requests annually to waive the additional levy payable by the vehicles' owners.

sections.label: Low transfer rate, COE speculation
sections.summary: About 0.3% of Cat A and Cat B vehicles are transferred within four to six months, suggesting the policy remains relevant against COE speculation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Over the same period, the proportion of Cat A and Cat B vehicles that are transferred within four to six months, as a proportion of the total Cat A and Cat B vehicles registered, is also very low, at about 0.3%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, I think these numbers do suggest that this policy tool remains relevant and useful as part of this suite of measures to counter COE speculation.

sections.label: Transfer to registered motorcar dealer
sections.summary: The appellant was told she could transfer the vehicle to a registered motorcar dealer, of which there are about 2,000.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Indeed, we have told the appellant that there is this route that she could take, by transferring it to the registered motorcar dealer.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We do have some 2,000 of these registered motorcar dealers.

sections.label: Monitoring policies against COE speculation
sections.summary: The low number suggests the measure remains useful and relevant, and policies against COE speculation continue to be monitored.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, basically, you cannot strip one out from the other.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But having said that, the low number is an indication, a suggestion, that it remains useful and relevant.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But we continue to monitor the various policies we have to counter COE speculation.
